name: Slab Philosopher
tagline: The wall isn't steep. Your mind is.
flavorText: You trust your feet more than most people trust their hands. Balance, patience, and precise footwork get you up things that look blank to everyone else — no need to rush, no need to grunt about it.
villainLine: They skip the feet entirely. You genuinely don't understand how they're still on the wall.
partnerLine: You provide the precision, they provide the power — together you cover every angle in the gym.
